question.text:
Type of isomerism which exists between 
$\left[\mathrm{Pd}\left(\mathrm{C}_6 \mathrm{H}_5\right)_2(\mathrm{SCN})_2\right]$ and $\left[\mathrm{Pd}\left(\mathrm{C}_6 \mathrm{H}_5\right)_2(\mathrm{NCS})_2\right]$ is :

solution.text:
The compound shows linkage isomerism because the ligand in the compound is an ambidenate ligand that can bond at more than one atomic site.
i.e., $: \mathrm{NCS}^{-}$and $: \mathrm{SCN}^{-}$
